title: ticks must fix cloud/sandbox's stale cloud/factory references so ticfac can re-pin and re-sync the vendored image context
body: The vendored image context's README.md, common.sh and worker.sh still reference cloud/factory/src/... for control-plane files that l9n moved to ticfac/cloudflare, and k4s then moved the tree to ticfac/image. Those trees are digest-pinned to ticks@e1146e6d and verified byte-for-byte, so neither move could edit them here: the fix must be authored in ticks' cloud/sandbox, then ticfac moves sandbox.pin.json's ref and runs `go run ./cmd/sandbox sync`. This is the same subject as l9n finding 4c8a55f8, which was triaged into k4s but was not completable from ticfac's isolated worktree — no ticks commit with the fixes exists to re-sync to, and pushing to ticks is an always-ask.
